notes:
Summary of account and requirements:
- Buyer: Global Ops + CTO + Security (legal looped). Primary contact: Sarah Blake, VP Ops.
- Use-case: post-call summaries (transcript -> 3 bullet coaching highlights), automatic ticket creation with routing, agent assist realtime snippets, QA scoring and coaching packs. Must support post-call QA exports to LMS.
- Scale: 18 contact centers globally, peak concurrent agents ~2,400, average daily calls ~85k, peak burst historically 3x baseline during promotions.
- Performance targets: post-call summary appear in CRM <30s after call end; short coaching highlights (3 items) and red-flags. Real-time assist latency <150ms for token-level hints. Throughput requirement: process 30k calls/day in POC; plan for 300k+ calls/day at scale.
- Models: prefer open models but want Redwood-verified variants; fallback to smaller quantized models during spikes. Must support model pinning and canary rollouts.
- Data flow: encrypted stream -> temporary KV cache -> S3 staging for POC replay. Need KMS integration for envelope encryption and audit logs for every inference.
- Security asks: SSO/SAML, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, retention controls (30/90/365 day variants), ability to run in customer VPC or on-prem appliance for EMEA clients.
- Commercial sensitivity: tight cost targets for per-call unit economics, expect Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce cost by >30% through batching/caching.
- Quote from Sarah (VP Ops): "If we can keep summaries accurate and latency predictable during our holiday spikes, we can replace two of three external QA vendors."
- Meeting notes: 2025-02-18 discovery call (Fireflies ff_20250218_crestpoint_intro) – deep dive on spike patterns and legal requirements. 2025-03-07 demo w/ POC plan presented (ff_20250307_poc_demo).
- POC ask: 30-day sandbox, ingest 30k demo calls (anonymized), run full QA rubric and deliver coaching packs for 50 agents. Also include one-week simulated spike (3x concurrent) with fallback behavior logged.
- Internal orientation: recommend Dedicated for baseline and Private for EU-regulated clients; keep Hosted for fast rollout to NA.
- Next steps captured: security packet delivered 2025-03-09 (drive link), SE to deliver spike test plan by 2025-03-17, legal to review MSA redlines (data residency) by 2025-03-21.
